snippet.title: AMAZE! (Mobile) Levels 1-100
snippet.description:
This is the 1st Episode of AMAZE! You color the Maze in many ways. When you paint all the levels, you get over 1000 Levels of This game.
It looks similar to Color Maze where you play Levels too. THANKS FOR WATCHING.
